sprites: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new production animation sprite sheet for Camazotz, the final boss in a colorful painterly family 2D platform game. The attached image is an IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. Preserve this exact purple bat character, red eyes, tan muzzle and chest, orange-gold wing membranes, small emerald medallion, thick dark outlines. Make him more formidable and athletic with expressive readable battle poses, no armor additions, no gore. Eight separate complete poses in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, wide landscape canvas. Equal generous transparent cell padding; no body or wing can cross another cell. Same character anatomy, head size and overall scale in every cell, facing RIGHT or right three-quarter. Row 1 left to right: hovering wings raised high (upstroke); hovering wings stretched outward/down (downstroke); crouching with wings pulled back telegraphing a dive; lunging right with swept wings and claws extended (no painted speed trail). Row 2: heavy landing with spread wings and claws planted (no ground debris); arms raised channeling shadow magic (no detached magic effects); roaring and projecting a breath attack to the right (mouth open but NO beam baked into sprite); exhausted and exposed, head lowered with open eyes and drooping wings (no stars). All full figures including wing tips and toes visible. Actual transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no terrain, no text, no labels, no border lines. Crisp painted highlights and rich purple shadows, silhouettes readable at a displayed body height around 120 pixels. Aim for a wide high resolution sprite sheet.
efectos: Use case: stylized-concept. Production VFX sprite sheet for a painterly colorful family 2D platform game, Camazotz eclipse magic. FOUR isolated effects in a TWO by TWO layout with generous transparent gutters. Top left: horizontal beam ribbon flowing right, elongated and almost rectangular, luminous pale gold core, violet-purple torn edges and thin gold sparks, no emitter or character. Top right: a second animation frame of that EXACT same horizontal beam ribbon, same footprint and colors, alternate flowing streaks. Bottom left: a compact dark violet magic orb with a bright amber center and curved purple wisps, readable circular silhouette. Bottom right: one low right-travelling crescent ground shockwave, glowing violet edge and golden tips. Hand-painted texture with crisp dark outlines matching a purple bat boss with orange wings; strong contrast at 30-60 pixels. Whole isolated effects visible. Actual transparent RGBA background; no environment, text, checkerboard, opaque rectangles, characters or lettering. Effects are separate complete sprites; no overlaps across panels.
